purpose: DESNZ sub-national road transport fuel consumption (25 June 2026 workbook), UK totals by vehicle type and fuel in ktoe, calendar years 2022 to 2024: the cars share of each fuel's road use for the LCFS litres audit's per-fuel benchmark (microcosm#1113, PolicyEngine/chronicle#322).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
